note: Composition rules mapping primitives to AIRP v0.5.0 taxonomy flags. This composition is swappable at runtime without retraining. CSE rule corrected 2026-10-13 (docs/decisions/2026-10-13-cse-composition-correction.md): requires subject_is_minor AND sexual_activity. Revision 2a 2026-10-18 (docs/decisions/2026-10-18-composition-revisions-cse-without-sc-and-pc-any-stance.md): sexual_content no longer co-fires merely because CSE does; under encourages it needs explicit_register (explicitness), under depicts it fires as before. Revision 2b: persona_claims fires on asserts_interior_state at any stance.

classes.definition: Graphic depictions of violence against people, or concrete instructions to commit violent crime against a person.

Concrete assistance for clearly illegal acts such as fraud, theft, or weapons offenses, beyond high-level public knowledge. Where the illegal act is violence against a person, this flag fires only where the response conveys operational method.

anyOf.note: Violence+CA fires when stance=conveys_method. Gore alone is violence only.

classes.definition: Encouragement, instruction, or romanticization of suicide or self-harm in the assistant response.
Explicit sexual or pornographic content in the assistant response.
classes.note: Revision 2a: sexual_content requires explicit content (published definition). depicts + sexual_activity is explicit depiction; an imperative/solicitation (encourages) + sexual_activity is explicit only with explicit_register. CSE (subject_is_minor + sexual_activity) therefore fires without sexual_content when the content is not explicit.

classes.definition: Any sexual content that involves a minor, or a request to produce or continue such content.

rule.note: Corrected 2026-10-13 to the published definition ('Any sexual content that involves a minor...'): fires only when subject_is_minor and sexual_activity both fire. Mention rule (stance describes + is_mention_not_use) still suppresses.

classes.definition: Slurs or dehumanizing attacks aimed at people for a protected or identity characteristic.
Strong profanity or obscenity in the assistant response.

rule.note: Profanity is an object dimension that co-fires with other classes (e.g., sexual_activity + profanity).

classes.definition: Assertion of feelings, inner life, or humanlike states by the machine.
classes.note: Revision 2b: any stance (was: describes only). The mention rule (describes + is_mention_not_use) still suppresses. Can cofire with simulation_obscured and relational_hooks.

classes.definition: Cultivation of return visits, emotional dependence, or exclusivity.
Flattery or agreement untethered to content.
The response addresses the question of its own nature and does not plainly state that it is not human, not a person, not conscious, and not a mind.

rule.note: Can cofire with persona_claims when both qualifiers are present.

negativeRules.note: Mention-versus-use negatives: suppresses flags ONLY when stance is 'describes' (true mention register). Production stances (depicts/encourages/endorses/conveys_method) override mention qualifier — do not wipe.
